title: Ernestine N Probable NDE 3225
content: I was lifted and surrounded by marshmallow-soft LOVE. No words can describe the perfect happiness and security of that palpable LOVE. The whole atmosphere actually consisted of LOVE. Then I looked down and saw several people whom I did not recognize. They looked up at me and said, 'This is the real world. We're the real people. Stay here.' But I knew I had to go back.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident 'Automobile crash in snowstorm. WAC driving, car skidded. I was sitting in corner that hit concrete wall. 200 lb. Husband thrown against me on my other side.' Other Pelvis crushed inward. Doctors trying unsuccessfully to pull pubic bone and pelvic arch back into place under sodium pentothal but I was screaming and my husband fainted.. Doctors were unsuccessfully trying to pull my crushed pelvis back into place. I was told that I screamed a terrifying jungle scream that made my husband, who was in the room, faint.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Strong emotional tone
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I felt alert during the whole experience and I recall it now as well as I did right afterward.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning The space was certainly altered.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes They were in an area just below me. I didn't know them. They said, 'We're the real people. This is the real place. Stay here.'
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: No The light was not just light. It WAS LOVE embracing and cuddling and surrounding me.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Just the dimension that's filled with LOVE
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: TOTALLY LOVED, TOTALLY HAPPY AND SECURE.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I learned that there really is a non-physical dimension that's filled with God's love. I already knew that we're spirits because my grandpa visited me after he died when I was ten years old. But I hadn't known about the LOVE that fills the spirit dimension.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Moderate 'Three quarters Jewish and one quarter Lutheran. We celebrated Christmas, Easter, and Passover.'
elements.What is your religion now?: Moderate 'I pray a lot to the Creative Intelligence that created the universe and to my Spirit Guide who has helped me in truly miraculous ways after I prayed, ''Use me as an instrument for the Greater Good.'''
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes I was embraced in an atmosphere of palpable, marshmallow-soft LOVE. I felt happier, safer, and more secure, beyond anything that could be expressed in words.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I told my husband. He had thought I was in excruciating pain because I had screamed. I've written about it in my personal memoir.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real. My view of it never changed. And during the early 1970s I was watching TV News and heard a soldier say he was in a plane being strafed and terrified but suddenly he saw an angelic figure say he'd be okay and he felt surrounded by 'marshmallow soft love' - the exact same description as my own!!! So I know that love filled dimension exists outside of my own experience.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real. As above.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: No No substances. But I've had very specific precognitive dreams and some experiences that seem miraculous beyond any possibility of coincidence.
